title: Telos-S prospective prediction registry entry (schema v1)
description: One JSON object per line in eval/prospective_registry.jsonl. Timestamps and config hashes are generated by modules/eval_harness.py, never by the caller.

registered_at.description: Server-generated UTC ISO-8601 timestamp, set at registration before the outcome is observed.

accession.description: GenBank accession with version, e.g. PZ155177.1.

isolate_label.description: External designation if known at registration time, e.g. XFG.5.1.7.

job_id.description: Telos-S backend job that produced this prediction.

code_git_sha.description: Short git SHA of the backend repo at registration, or 'unknown'.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of config_snapshot.

config_snapshot.description: Frozen scoring/threshold constants (see FROZEN_CONFIG_KEYS in eval_harness.py).

esm_model.description: ESM-2 model id used, e.g. facebook/esm2_t33_650M_UR50D.

pst_pct.description: Structural transition probability in percent; ALERT if > 20 (§2.5.2).
